INSERT INTO outbox_delivery_attempts (event_id, event_type, employee_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = event_id;
SELECT event_id, attempts, status FROM outbox_delivery_attempts WHERE event_id = $4

UPDATE outbox_delivery_attempts SET attempts = attempts + 1, status = 'sending', last_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id = $1 AND (status IN ('pending', 'failed') OR (status = 'sending' AND last_attempt_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 2 HOUR))
